issue_request: FHIR-14066 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked the search page to clarify what text is 'associated' with a code/value for the :text modifier and whether matching is exact, starts-with, contains, fuzzy, or case-sensitive. The accepted resolution identified CodeableConcept.text, Coding.display, and Identifier.type.text and said the modifier should function as a normal string search, case-insensitive and able to match the first part.
initial_application: Git commit 08aa67be14638daebe3ccadba9a34ef64177c46a, matching the Jira SVN application comment, changed source/search.html for GF#14066 to add that token :text functions as a normal string search after the associated text list.
additional_context: Later search work reorganized source/search.html and refined the same area. FHIR-35812 expanded Identifier-related text handling, FHIR-31708 decided not to remove Identifier.type.text behavior, and FHIR-32673 introduced text-advanced/code-text for advanced token text matching instead of changing the basic token :text rule. A 2020 Zulip thread and later implementer threads show the same normal-string-versus-advanced ambiguity, but no evidence that the seed's basic clarification should now be changed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/search.html states that the text modifier on reference and token search parameters matches CodeableConcept.text, Coding.display, Identifier.type.text, Identifier.type.coding.display, Identifier.assigner.display, or Reference.display using basic string matching, explicitly begins with or is and case-insensitive, with the same rule repeated in the detailed modifier section.
